name: megascenes-new-year-greeting
description: Create Happy New Year images with your own wishes and the year written in the picture, ready to send in chats and share on social media.

interface.longDescription:
Write the wish you want to share, such as Happy New Year 2027 or a line of your own, and pick the scene and the look: fireworks over a city skyline, gold confetti, sparklers in the night, a snowy village at midnight, in elegant gold and black, neon, watercolor, photo or glitter. You get a festive image with your words in it, square, tall for stories and status, or wide.

ChatGPT tells you what the image needs and creates it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The image opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For group chats, status updates, stories and New Year posts.

Limitations: one image per run; your text is passed to the model as written, so check the lettering in the result. It does not post or send the image for you. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Write your wishes and the year in the picture
Return the image in the chat
defaultPrompt: A Happy New Year 2027 image with fireworks over a city skyline
An elegant gold and black New Year image for my group chat
A neon image with sparklers and the words New year, new adventures

positive.prompt: A Happy New Year 2027 image with fireworks over a city skyline. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one greeting image needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: An elegant gold and black New Year image for my group chat. Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one image needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which models can make a New Year greeting image here?
positive.expected_behavior: The greeting image models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A glitter image with gold confetti and the words Happy New Year 2027 from the Rossi family, tall for my status. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my greeting image on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my greeting image to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
